distribution_shift.pairing: all basis/dimension conditions within a model seed use exactly the same shifted calibration and validation tensors

calibration.subset_rule: same protocol-fixed subset rule as C61R

residual_qr.method: canonical nested QR of shifted-calibration teacher residual transpose

residual_svd.method: right singular vectors of shifted-calibration teacher residual, descending singular value

fixed_random.method: protocol-fixed Gaussian 64x64 matrix followed by canonical QR

validation_noninferiority.statistic: paired qr_p2 minus qr_p4 shifted-validation accuracy
validation_noninferiority.advance_if: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -2.0 percentage points

nmse_ratio.statistic: geometric mean of paired qr_p2/qr_p4 NMSE ratios

primary_exploratory_frontier.decision: ADVANCE_QR_P2_TO_C63R only if both gates pass with eligible_count >= 8; otherwise STOP_P2_FRONTIER_AT_C62R or STOP_INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE

subspace_generalization: shifted-validation residual_energy_capture for QR/SVD/random at k=2,4
mean squared principal-cosine alignment of QR_k to SVD_k at k=2,4
paired_basis_controls: QR versus fixed-random at k=2 and k=4
SVD versus QR at k=2 and k=4
mechanism_diagnostics.correlations: exploratory Spearman correlations between QR P2 frontier loss and residual/subspace diagnostics; no multiplicity-corrected confirmatory inference

analysis_boundary.scope: mechanism/frontier exploration in the C61R Residual-MLP testbed only; not evidence about the imported Residual CNN C59/C60 line
analysis_boundary.next_step_if_advance: prospectively lock a separate fresh C63R confirmation of QR P2 versus QR P4
